title: 0.2.19 OTA recovery update
summary: This update fixes the 0.2.18 in-platform update hang after file application and makes OTA sync/rollback overwrite changed runtime files more reliably.
highlights: Fixed service restart after OTA when the install path contains spaces such as C:\Program Files.
OTA sync and rollback now overwrite same-size runtime files instead of relying only on robocopy timestamp heuristics.
Added a regression test that starts the backend from an install path with spaces.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
